title: Site workspace keeps its Browser tab: no close route on the last one, one per conversation, and a comment pressed with no Browser tab opens it on its thread
steps: Common setup. Site S = the stand's Joomla site (scv2jo), then repeat with its EmDash site (scv2em). Seat A.
S1: Create a whole-page comment: api a POST /api/sites/<S>/comments '{"url":"http://<S>:<port>/","text":"REG-022"}'; keep its comment.id as C.

S2: New browser context with A's cookie. goto $O/<S>/; wait (<=120 s) for the URL to hold /s/session- and for .tracy-boot-cover to be gone; wait (<=60 s) for a visible [data-dockkit-tab] that contains [data-site-icon] (the Browser chip).
S3: Read that chip: whether it contains [data-dockkit-tab-close]. Right-click it, wait 500 ms, count [data-dockkit-menu-close]; press Escape.
S4: Click [data-sidebar-right-toggle]; check button[aria-label="Open right sidebar"] is visible; click it; count the visible Browser chips again.

S5: Fill [data-composer-input='true'] with 'REG-022 first', press Enter, wait 3 s; click button[aria-label="New session"]; wait for the /s/session-… part of the URL to change; wait (<=30 s) for a visible Browser chip; read its aria-selected and whether [data-browser-tab] has a client rect.

S6: New browser context (empty localStorage) with A's cookie. goto $O/<S>/?tab=tracy:changes&site=<S>; wait for the boot cover to go and 6 s more; record whether [data-browser-tab] exists (expected: not yet, the Browser tab sits behind Site changes unvisited). Listen on window for 'tracy:comment-list' details. Click the first button with text 'Comments' (the chat column's Comments view), click 'All pages', wait for [data-comment="C"], click it.
S7: Wait (<=45 s) for a tracy:comment-list detail whose thread === C; then read whether [data-browser-tab] exists.
expect: S3: the Browser chip has no [data-dockkit-tab-close]; its menu has 0 [data-dockkit-menu-close].
S4: after the toggle the 'Open right sidebar' button is visible (column collapsed); after reopening exactly one visible Browser chip.
S5: the session id changed; the new conversation has exactly one visible Browser chip, aria-selected="true", no close button, and [data-browser-tab] is on screen (not 'Click + to start').
S7: a list names thread C, and [data-browser-tab] exists (the Browser tab opened on the comment's page and its thread card is open).
evidence: Screenshots 03/10/2026: the Browser tab had a close button, and with it closed a Comments row press did nothing ('Click + to start'). Stand bpin 03/10: 5/5 on Joomla and EmDash, tasks/evidence/browser-tab-ghim/
fence: dsh keepLast (canCloseTab), dsh-better-sidebar tracy:browser keepLast, tracy-my-sites everySeat + openBehind, tracy-chat-input revealOf + tracy-site-tabs tracy:comment-open
